- Deformation substructure evolution of the FCC(L12) and B2 phases during tension of this EHEA is undeciphered

Question: The TEM series follows FCC(L12)/B2 lamellae through room-temperature tension interrupted at 0.6% and 1.5% strain and then to fracture. At 0.6% strain the FCC lamellae already show dislocations and planar slip while the B2 lamellae remain dislocation-free. In panel F4d (scale bar 0.2 μm), what does the dislocation arrangement within the FCC lamellae look like?
